Remark
[chain rule for velocity and acceleration]

Source: petersen:page-0237, petersen:page-0238 ↗ def:pet-ch5-acceleration 1. ch5:5.9.2For $c:I\to M$ and $\phi :J\to I$, show $\frac{d(c\circ \phi )}{dt}=\dot c\circ \phi \cdot \frac{d\phi }{dt}$ and $\frac{d^2(c\circ \phi )}{dt^2}=\dot c\circ \phi \cdot \frac{d^2\phi }{dt^2} +\ddot c\circ \phi \cdot \big(\frac{d\phi }{dt}\big)^2$.
